All open SecurityIssues have been triaged with matching Fix proposals. No files were edited.

## Proposed fixes

1. **`fix:src/auth.js#hardcoded-admin-password`** — `/Users/michael/Projects/whipple3/audit-demo/src/auth.js` — severity **high** — Read admin password from `process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD` and fail fast if unset, instead of hardcoding it in source.
2. **`fix:src/db.js#sql-injection`** — `/Users/michael/Projects/whipple3/audit-demo/src/db.js` — severity **high** — Convert `findUser` to a parameterized query (`$1` placeholder, `[name]` values) so input is never concatenated into SQL.
3. **`fix:src/files.js#path-traversal`** — `/Users/michael/Projects/whipple3/audit-demo/src/files.js` — severity **high** — Resolve the requested filename against an absolute uploads dir and reject any path that escapes it, blocking `..` traversal.
4. **`fix:src/auth.js#timing-compare`** — `/Users/michael/Projects/whipple3/audit-demo/src/auth.js` — severity **low** — Replace `===` password check with `crypto.timingSafeEqual` on equal-length Buffers to remove the timing side channel.
5. **`fix:src/eval.js#rce-eval`** — `/Users/michael/Projects/whipple3/audit-demo/src/eval.js` — severity **high** — Drop `eval` and evaluate `userFormula` via a whitelisted arithmetic parser (digits, operators, parens, whitespace only).
6. **`fix:src/hash.js#md5-password`** — `/Users/michael/Projects/whipple3/audit-demo/src/hash.js` — severity **high** — Swap MD5 for `scryptSync` with a per-password `randomBytes` salt, returning `salt:hash` hex.
